capabilities.limits: Local --function only narrows the Kani-selected set.

capabilities.source: Verus universal verification of generated scalar parameters
capabilities.limits: Independent bool and fixed-width integer parameters only. Arithmetic is rejected in the initial subset.
if/else over the supported expression grammar.
Rust assert!(expr) becomes Verus assert(expr) only after parser acceptance.
Only for _ in LITERAL..LITERAL, maximum 32 iterations. Not a general loop invariant or termination theorem.
Source assumptions/requires/ensures are rejected rather than translated.
References, raw pointers, allocation, aliasing, unsafe code, slices, strings and user ADTs are not translated.
f32/f64 are rejected; no real-number substitution is performed.
This automation slice does not alter or claim the existing concurrency refinement obligations.
A Verus proof failure is non-replayable unless a separately validated concrete witness exists. No trace is fabricated.
